mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, the 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 9.5% indicates high unemployment, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 9.5%, the 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling employment (PAYEMS) signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 90 and PAYEMS < 130000, the 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher risk aversion.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months, the 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST value below 500 signals weak housing market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 500, the 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 220 (annualized inflation rate > 2.5%) signals inflationary pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 220, the 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO above 90 indicates a strengthening economy that boosts corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 90, the 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 value below 13200 (annualized GDP growth < 2.0%) signals a slowing economy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 13200, the 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
